thread:
Iris: RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight compatibility normalizer in front of the API proxy to accept legacy v1 clients and translate to v2 shape at the edge. goal: minimal codepath, tenant opt-in, full telemetry and scrubbed sampling for debugging
Noah: high-level yes. main risks: added latency and added complexity around routing/policies in the proxy layer
Iris: design constraints: no persistent state, no KV mutation, pure functional transform. perf target: <=1ms median, <12ms p99 at typical load. we'll run k6 load tests to validate
Priya: can you list the concrete transforms we expect? last time we hit surprises: v1 allowed array ops, v2 expects single op with instructions metadata
Iris: short mapping doc in-line:
- v1: {"ops": [{"type":"complete","input":"..."}], "options": {"model":"rwd-small"}}
- v2: {"payload": {"action":"complete","input":"..."}, "metadata": {"source":"v1"}}
Iris: normalizer picks first op, normalizes option keys (model->engine), drops deprecated 'trace_id' if present, attach header X-Compat-From: v1
Luis: opt-in mechanism? feature flag or tenant config? If config, how fast can SRE flip it for an affected tenant?
Noah: tenant-config controlled with immediate effect. add a TTL so we encourage migration (e.g., opt-in expires after 90 days unless renewed)
Priya: telemetry requirements: transformed_count, transform_errors, transform_rejects, sample_payloads_scrubbed. also histogram of added latency. namesproposal: compat.normalize.total, compat.normalize.errors, compat.normalize.latency_ms
Iris: agreed. sample payloads must be sanitized (remove text content) and access-controlled. store only hashes + shape for 30 days
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: proxy/compat-normalizer v0.1 -> staging (requested by @Iris)
Luis: failure scenarios: incorrect mapping could change model/engine selection or drop a user-intent field. Safety: always record original request hash in trace and keep a 7-day ephemeral capture (encrypted) to allow replaying for debugging
Priya: what about partial failures? e.g., transform logic throws for edge cases. Should we fall back to passthrough to v1 backends, or return a deterministic error?
Noah: prefer passthrough to v1 backend while that backend is still present. If v1 backend removed, return explicit 422 with migration guidance. Also protect with rate-limited retry and circuit breakers so failing transforms don't overload v1 service
Iris: rollout plan suggestion: 1) deploy code disabled 2) enable 0.01% sampling to collect transforms 3) opt-in internal tenants + run synthetic tests 4) expand to 3% canary tenants 5) monitor 14 days 6) widen in waves with comms
Luis: add auto-rollback: if transform_errors > 1% for any tenant or added latency p99 increases > 50ms, automatically opt that tenant out and open an alert in #incidents. Also post webhook to account owner
Priya: logging/tracing: set span attribute compat.normalizer.applied=true/false and compat.normalizer.ruleset=ops-first. Also emit X-Redwood-CompatHeader: v1->v2 in requests to downstream for observability
Iris: security note: normalizer must not modify or read auth tokens. tenant identity must be derived strictly from token introspection and never from payload fields. drop any tenant-like fields before transforming
Noah: tests: unit coverage per transform rule, property tests for random payloads, e2e with canary tenants, chaos tests where we artificially inject malformed v1 shapes
Iris: long-term cleanup: target removal window of 9-15 months post-stable adoption. We will publish a deprecation schedule in console and provide migration tooling. Exceptions for large enterprise customers via support SLA
Luis: naming nit: feature flag should be compat.normalizer.enabled to avoid ambiguity with other gateway features
Iris: done. checklist before staging: mapping doc finalized, dashboards for compat.normalize.* ready, circuit-breaker config added, security review complete, migration comms drafted
Priya: can we include a migration webhook payload sample in the playbook so customer success can automate outreach?
Iris: will add sample webhook + suggested email copy. thanks all
deploy-bot: deployed: proxy/compat-normalizer v0.1 -> staging at 2024-05-02T09:45:12Z
Noah: scheduling 45m post-deploy call to validate p50/p99 numbers and review sampled transforms
Iris: calendar invite shared. :white_check_mark:
